    input logic reset,
    input logic [8:0] scan_x,
    input logic [8:0] scan_y,
    input pixel_t composed_pixel
);

  (* maybe_unused *)

    if (reset) begin
    end else begin
      if (scan_x < 240 && scan_y < 160) begin
        framebuffer[scan_x][scan_y] <= composed_pixel;
      end
    end
  end

endmodule : GBA_Framebuffer

No. Builds, but not full expected GBA PPU.

Major gaps:

- Only Mode 0 renders. Modes 1–5, OBJ, windows, mosaic, blending absent.
- `forced_blank` ignored.
- Backdrop color absent. Transparent BG result becomes zero, not palette backdrop.
- `DISPSTAT` status flags and `VCOUNT` never updated. Reads wrong.
- `interrupt_bus.vcounter_req` never driven. Likely `X`.
- HBlank/VBlank IRQ requests ignore `DISPSTAT` enable bits.
- Framebuffer writes same pixel four times; harmless, wasteful.
- `bg_line` written but never used.
- No PPU tests verify raster timing, register reads, Mode 0 pixels, priority, scrolling.

Mode 0 text-BG path looks structurally plausible after `scan_x[7:0]` fix. Need directed tests before claim expected behavior.

reflections.content: PPU.sv indexes 240-entry bg_line arrays with scan_x[7:0] under the enclosing scan_x < 240 guard, fixing Verilator WIDTHTRUNC errors.
The current GBA PPU is not a full expected implementation: it only renders Mode 0 and lacks Modes 1–5, OBJ, windows, mosaic, and blending.
The GBA PPU display path does not consume bg_line: GBA_PPU writes it, but Compositor uses live bg_pixel values before GBA_Framebuffer receives composed_pixel.
GBA PPU timing/status behavior is incomplete: DISPSTAT flags and VCOUNT are not updated, vcounter_req is undriven, and HBlank/VBlank IRQ requests ignore DISPSTAT enable bits.
The project has no PPU tests for raster timing, register reads, Mode 0 pixels, priority, or scrolling, so directed tests are required before claiming expected behavior.
